_doc: Devices and firing times for the dashboard v1 recurring job (docs/dashboard-recurring-job-v1.md). scripts/dashboard_job.py reads this; nothing here is a measurement. Paths under hold/hold_cli are the sibling conversion lane's device-hold protocol on the bench host (docs/OPERATIONS.md, 'A phone is shared with other lanes').
_slots_doc: launchd runs `./bench dashboard-job auto` at these local times every night (the plist template carries the same times). `auto` measures, among the devices with no admitted dashboard session since Monday 00:00 local, the attached unheld one whose last admitted session is oldest — the iPhone only inside its auto_window after auto_idle_hours without a record, the Mac only while no heavy export pipeline runs. One device per firing; each device once a week; a firing with nothing pending exits 0.

m4max.window: any firing while no heavy export pipeline runs (unified-memory contention: the runner refuses and the job passes over the Mac until it is quiet)

extra_cells._doc: ONNX Runtime GenAI, the two Qwen3 short-chat cells that give valid runs on this phone (owner GO 2026-10-09); runs as its own tagged session (-ort) after the set, whole or halves

llama.cpp on the NPU and the Adreno GPU (side build b11469-snapdragon): the session anchor and the short-chat cells of matrices/dashboard-npu-v1-android-s26.cells (owner GO 2026-10-09; the 1K and protocol cells stay by-hand); its own tagged session (-npu) after the ONNX Runtime one, about 2.1 h; skipped while /data/local/tmp/llmbench/engines/b11469-snapdragon is not on the phone (android/README.md, 'Side builds'). Its five GGUF files are the storage halves' own copies (a: Qwen3 0.6B / 1.7B, Gemma 4 E2B; b1: Qwen3 4B; b2: Gemma 4 E4B), on the phone when it starts; min_free_gb is the room to push back the ones a rotation between the halves can take away (Qwen3 1.7B, Gemma 4 E2B, Qwen3 4B: 6.6 GB as the job counts space, KiB / 10^6, on the phone's models/ listing of 2026-10-08), not its 11.8 GB footprint: a floor above the free space the halves leave (13.9 GB after them on 2026-10-05) would rotate the halves' LiteRT bundles and caches out every week

s26.window: any firing; USB attached, screen on or off (read and stamped per launch); runs unmasked (devices/galaxy-s26.md); the NPU / GPU session needs the llama.cpp side build in /data/local/tmp/llmbench/engines/b11469-snapdragon on the phone

pixel8a.window: any firing; USB attached, screen on or off (read and stamped per launch); storage-limited, so the set runs as three sessions with pushed models rotated out between them

iphone17pro.window: the 05:30 firing only (auto_window 05:00-08:00 local) and only after 4 h without a record from the phone (auto_idle_hours); the phone must be unlocked (Auto-Lock Never) or the headless launch is refused, and a plugged phone in a warm room reports 'fair' (admitted only through the anchor rule)

iphone18pro.window: the 05:30 firing only (auto_window 05:00-08:00 local) and only after 4 h without a record from the phone (auto_idle_hours); the bench iPhone, kept on USB; it must be unlocked (Auto-Lock Never) or the headless launch is refused. udid is the UDID that `devicectl list devices` prints (the job finds the phone there by it); hold is the iPhone lanes' own lockfile (noclobber, a JSON line with a keeper pid or a text line)
